gloss: year-round; all year; throughout the year

definitions.gloss: year-round; all year; throughout the year
definitions.explanation: Spanning or available throughout the entire year, not limited to a particular season. Often used as an adverbial modifier.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通年|つうねん}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通年|つうねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{温暖|おんだん}→温暖：02596_ondan⟧な⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Okinawa enjoys a warm climate throughout the year.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{農園|のうえん}→農園：26824_nouen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通年|つうねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{栽培|さいばい}して→栽培する：09860_saibaisuru⟧おり、⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず⟦{出荷|しゅっか}→出荷：05135_shukka⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This farm grows various vegetables year-round and can ship regardless of the season.

notes:
Used to indicate that something continues or is available throughout all four seasons. Typically modifies a noun or verb phrase.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通年|つうねん}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧ (open year-round)
- {通年|つうねん}{採用|さいよう} (year-round hiring)
- {通年|つうねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{利用|りよう}できる→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧ (available year-round)

Contrasts with ⟦{季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}→季節限定：09823_kisetsugentei⟧ (seasonal/limited to a season). Commonly appears in business, tourism, and agriculture contexts.
